# MDN Web Docs

> > MDN Web Docs is the authoritative resource for web developers, providing comprehensive documentation on web technologies, standards, and best practices.

MDN (Mozilla Developer Network) serves as the definitive reference for HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Web APIs, and modern web development practices. The platform includes tutorials, guides, and reference documentation maintained by Mozilla and the open-source community.

## Key Topics

- Web Security
- SubResource Integrity (SRI)
- CDN Security
- DevSecOps
- GitHub to GitLab Migration
- CI/CD Pipelines
- Repository Migration
- Web Development Curriculum
- Third-party Resources
- Content Delivery Networks
- Git Large File Storage (LFS)
- Script Integrity
- CORS and Crossorigin
- Project Import
- Learning Resources

## Web Development Learning Resources

- [A new learning experience on MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/blog/curriculum-learn-web-development): Announcement of MDN's new Learn Web Development section and curriculum

## Web Security Best Practices

- [Securing your CDN: Why and how should you use SRI](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/blog/securing-cdn-using-sri-why-how): Guide on securing CDN resources using SubResource Integrity (SRI)

## DevOps and Migration Guides

- [Migrating from GitHub to GitLab seamlessly: A step-by-step guide](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/blog/migrating-from-github-to-gitlab-seamlessly-a-step-by-step-guide): Step-by-step guide for DevSecOps teams migrating from GitHub to GitLab
